textContract.articleMarkdown: Full final article, never a summary or outline; equal to cards/{locale}/{cardId}.md
textContract.sections: Complete ordered semantic sections with stable IDs/roles, titles and full bodyMarkdown; section counts legitimately vary by original batch
textContract.sourceRecord: Original Chinese batch-level authoring record preserved where present; not target-language display text
textContract.translationInputMetadata: Original translator extra metadata; raw full input files retained in provenance/translation-inputs
textContract.image: Canonical observation provenance and hashes retained; image bytes omitted, observedAsset.packagePath=null
textContract.numbers: deckOrder0–77; majorNumber0–21; number string; StrengthVIII,JusticeXI; canonical wheel/judgement IDs
textContract.publication: Manuscripts only, no page routes registered, no repo/site mutations
textContract.normalization: Add canonical v3 identity and review fields; canonical image provenance includes portable no-bundle flags; target full article text is byte-unchanged from approved translator output

imagePolicy: Reuse existing application assets after checking current repository mapping. Do not replace them with external scans solely because a source URL is listed.
reviewLimit: Independent model editorial review, not native-human or specialist certification.
